title: skills(objectui): page-builder guide still teaches the retired page:header key `breadcrumb`
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhJG3tKnksHVa1krBz

Found while reviewing PR #30028 (card #30018), out of its scope.

`skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` (around line 101 on `main`) lists `breadcrumb` on the `page:header` row. `PageHeaderProps.breadcrumb` is a `retiredKey` tombstone since @objectstack/spec 17 (ADR-0087 D2, #20758): no renderer drew a trail for it, and an authored `breadcrumb` is refused by the props lint. An agent following the guide writes a key the platform refuses.

## Wanted

- Drop `breadcrumb` from the guide's `page:header` key list (and any example that sets it); if the guide lists header keys, name `subtitle`, `actions`, `recordChrome`, `showCopyId`, `maxVisible` as the live ones, and `placedActions` once #30028 lands.
- Re-check the rest of `skills/objectui/**` for `breadcrumb` and `showStar` on `page:header` (both retired).

Size S, docs/skills only.
